title: Ice Columns & Keycards: The Trooper's Resolve
summary: In a land of imposing ice columns, a lone trooper with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids hustles against frostbite and devastation, a macaque her only comfort. Judgment hangs heavy, a narwhal a silent witness. Prodded by a flighty, frozen monkey, this thrifty hero clutches a glowing keycard amidst destruction. A heartless, impish expert's venomous presence is a tarnation, kicking at their resolve. With nerve-wracking labor, they affix a pearl necklace as an earthquake rages. A hologram of intellect and past flickers. The ultimate villainy reshaped the vast land, but the unstoppable trooper, backpack ready, surveys new reddish verticals and an offramp. A panther observes, a wistful reminder.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
